DIAGRAMS.NFO                                          HALL 1.3
================================================================
Fifteen Rosicrucian and Qabbalistic Diagrams
Manly P. Hall · 1928 · folio p.450 · ECHO ROSE.CRUX

THESIS
  Fifteen pictures do the work of fifteen chapters: heavens, tomb, city, secret of nature.

POINTS
  * Schamayim, ocean of spirit
  * Seven days of creation
  * Tomb of C.R.C.
  * Regions of the elements
  * New Jerusalem

SEE ALSO  sephiroth  rose-cross  alchemy-1  chemical-marriage
DEGREE    NEOPHYTE may read this screen
================================================================
translation: Hall believes some doctrines only live as pictures. This chapter is a guided tour of plates: the ocean of spirit, creation as a week, the tomb that is a classroom, the four elemental regions, the New Jerusalem as a finished city-diagram. It is the folio's apology for Knapp. Read it with the Tree chapter. One is ten globes; this is fifteen engravings.
